notes.title: ❗ Fatal Error correction
notes.notes:
[b]Critical Fix – Windows Launch Issue Resolved[/b]
A critical issue that prevented the game from launching on Windows systems has been resolved. We sincerely apologize to all players affected by this problem and deeply appreciate those who reported it promptly.

Thank you for your continued support and patience. We're committed to delivering the best experience possible and are actively working on more updates!

notes.title: Version Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]📢 Patch Notes – Update 1.1.2![/h1]
This patch brings improvements to the player experience and adjustments to make settings more intuitive!

[h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bug Fixes: Various issues have been resolved to improve game stability and fluidity.
[*] Renamed Settings: Some setting names have been adjusted to better reflect their functions.
[*] Setting Adjustments: Certain options have been enabled or disabled by default to provide a better gameplay experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback! We're working on exciting new content and can't wait to share more details about!

notes.title: Cursor Inventory & Steam Drop Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]📢 Patch Notes – Update 1.1.0![/h1]

This update introduces an inventory system, UI improvements, and a brand-new game mode!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45122461/64fa3b2e6c6efb01220207fa38b595ba60ad5282.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory System: Players can now view and manage items received from Steam directly in-game! Additionally, cursors can be equipped to further customize the experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45122461/4301facdece069486eae130abb7ac4202cdbe7af.png[/img]
[*] New Level & Game Mode Selection UI: The level selection and game mode selection screens have been completely redesigned for smoother navigation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45122461/58db0f87c943b0b04ebeeb3aaba8c520a0618d25.png[/img]
[*] New Game Mode – Random Mode: Objects will now appear in different positions each time you play, adding more variety and challenge.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main Menu UI Enhancements: Several optimizations have been made to improve the responsiveness and usability of the main menu.
[*] Future Update Support: Additional improvements have been implemented to ensure better support for upcoming updates.
[/list]

Thank you for your support! Let us know what you think and enjoy the new features! 🎮✨

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]📢 Patch Notes – Update 1.0.4![/h1]
This update brings important gameplay improvements and new collectible items!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[b]New Collectible Items[/b]: Players can now randomly obtain new cursor variants while playing!
[list]
[*] Red Cursor
[*] Green Cursor
[*] Blue Cursor
[*] White Cursor
[*] Black Cursor
[*] Catpaw Cursor
[/list]

[b]Item Drop System[/b]: Items can now be earned every hour of gameplay.
[b]Future Customization[/b]: In future updates, these items will be equipable to change your cursor in-game.
[b]Marketplace Support[/b]: Items can now be purchased in the Steam Store, as well as traded or sold to other players.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[b]Creature Discovery Delay Removed[/b]: Thanks to community feedback, the delay that occurred when discovering creatures has been eliminated, providing a smoother gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support! Let us know what you think, and enjoy the new content. 🚀

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
📢 Patch Notes – New Update Available!
We’re excited to roll out a new update packed with important fixes and improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Preparation for Steam Inventory Integration: We've laid the groundwork for future Steam inventory support, ensuring a smoother experience when this feature goes live.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Statistics Accuracy Fixed: Player statistics now correctly reflect in-game values.
[*] Leaderboard Visibility Restored: The Steam leaderboard is now properly displayed on the game’s Steam page.
[*] Leaderboard Data Fixed: Leaderboard entries now display the correct values inside the game.
[*] Font Rendering Issue Resolved: Numbers and letters with faulty fonts that triggered incorrect fallbacks have been fixed, ensuring proper readability.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support! Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: New Feature 1.0.2
notes.notes: An "Auto Scroll" option has been added to the game, allowing for better integration for players using Remote Play on mobile devices.

notes.title: Bug Correction 1.0.1
notes.notes: We fixed a small issue in speedrun mode that was conflicting with the standard mode save.
